title: Merge Sorted Array - Solution
approach: Three pointers starting from indices m-1, n-1, and m+n-1 working backwards.
intuition: Given two sorted integer arrays nums1 and nums2, merge nums2 into nums1 as one sorted array. nums1 has size m+n where first m are elements to merge.
step_by_step_explanation: Iterate through elements and apply logic accordingly.
optimized_approach: Three pointers starting from indices m-1, n-1, and m+n-1 working backwards.
common_mistakes: Start merging from the end of the arrays to avoid overwriting elements in nums1.
